metadata.snapshotPolicy: Runtime visualization uses this bundled JSON. External links are provenance, not live dependencies.

legend.DERIVED: 正規化・補間・集計した値
legend.SCENARIO: 観客入力または明示した仮定による仮想状態

statisticalPolicy.principle: Observed values are never overwritten. Every filled or projected value carries a DERIVED or SCENARIO label.
statisticalPolicy.numericMissingness: Interpolate only when the variable is numeric and a defensible neighborhood or time model exists.
statisticalPolicy.structuralMissingness: Do not fill periods before station opening, after station closure, absent categorical metadata, or unobserved biological relationships.
statisticalPolicy.uncertainty: Show holdout error or prediction interval where the model permits; neither is measurement uncertainty.
